name: Plyph
description:
Plyph turns selected text into customizable AI actions anywhere in GNOME. Use local Ollama, OpenAI-compatible servers, cloud providers with your own API key, or sign in with your ChatGPT account.

Access your actions through a compact toolbar beside selected text or a floating button. Create custom actions to transform text or use the selection directly as a prompt, with optional per-action provider, model, and token settings. Control thinking effort when using your ChatGPT account.

Preview results, highlight changes, or automatically paste results back into the active application. Reads selected text through the clipboard and sends it to your chosen provider only when you explicitly trigger an action.
